expectations.subject: Jonah Coleman
expectations.statement: If his availability and backfield competition do not materially change, Coleman should remain involved in both rushing and receiving rather than depend only on a touchdown.
expectations.support: Week8 11 carries and5 targets versusDobbins7 carries; new price5300.
expectations.uncertainty: Single game; Harvey availability and all backfield roles not verified forWeek9.
expectations.challenge: A reduced role or disappearance of receiving opportunity despite active status would challenge the premise.
expectations.observe: Postgame carries, targets, receptions and teammate distribution; routes/snaps unassessable without a reliable source.

expectations.subject: Adonai Mitchell
expectations.statement: Mitchell is selected for continued meaningful receiving involvement alongside Wilson, not for a repeat of142yards or an assumed team-leading share.
expectations.support: FreshWeek8 box:9targets versusWilson12; prior zero-catch week is contrary evidence.
expectations.uncertainty: One strong game, current receiver availability andWeek9QB/protection conditions uncertain.
expectations.challenge: Few receiving opportunities while active and teammates continue drawing targets would challenge the role selection.
expectations.observe: Targets, receptions, team attempts and receiver distribution; distinguish a low-volume team game from loss of individual share.

expectations.subject: Harold Fannin Jr.
expectations.statement: Fannin should retain a meaningful receiving role if active, rather than be chosen merely because last week's154yards must recur.
expectations.support: Week8 12 targets versusConcepcion4 andBoston11; olderWeek6three-target failure remains relevant contrary evidence.
expectations.uncertainty: ClevelandQB continuity, protection and blocking deployment not established; a prior bounce does not prove persistence.
expectations.challenge: Targets shift away while he is active, or evidence he primarily blocks, would challenge the role premise.
expectations.observe: Targets/receptions versus team attempts and other receivers; assess QB changes and any sourced routes/blocking separately from points.
